about: Synthetic twin of the 2026-09-25 Pardo recording (Sprint F1 T5). An invented presenter introduces himself for 40 s at -28 dBFS on the call channel while the microphone carries -20 dBFS of room noise; then the talk continues at normal level. The first decode writes the prompt back over the quiet introduction. No real people, companies or audio: the speech is the bundled probe clip, the words are scripted.

truth.text: Good afternoon and welcome to the first showing of the Tessaline 58 here in the harbour today.
My name is Corvin Aldmere and I am a broker with Harbourline Yachts, so please come and find me afterwards.
Before we go aboard, a word on the hull, which was laid up in one piece this spring.
Now if you step this way you will see the saloon, with the galley aft and the helm forward.
The tender garage takes a three metre jet tender, and the swim platform lowers into the water.
